texts.settings page: ⚠ This noticeboard still uses the default admin password. Anyone on your network who knows it can change what's on your screens. Change the password in Settings. Settings Display Default image duration (seconds) Used by every slideshow that doesn't set its own duration. Videos always play to the end. Show the location pin in the viewer's top-left corner. It shows the Noticeboard server's address, so people can find the noticeboard from another device. Save Saved. MAC filtering Enable MAC filter (only approved devices can connect) No approved devices. Add Save Branding Logo Shown above No slideshow published on the displays when nothing is on, and above the title in this sidebar. A logo you upload is scaled down to fit 500 × 500 pixels if it's bigger; it's never stretched or enlarged. Show the logo The default logo Upload a logo… Background colour Fills the screen around a slide that doesn't fill it (for example, a landscape picture on a portrait screen), and behind the logo when nothing is published. Slides are never cut off or stretched. Pick a colour, or type its code (e.g. #000000 for black). Save Change password Current password New password Confirm new password Change password Software updates Running feature/look-test SHA · updates now come from main Updates Checked every 15 minutes. Last update Done TIME Updated to SHA from main. Update schedule Install updates Every 15 minutes Every 2 hours Daily Weekly Manual A new version is installed within 15 minutes of being published. Times are the noticeboard's own clock. Save Branch Updates come from the main branch on GitHub. main is the stable version; other branches hold work in progress. Nothing changes until you've checked the branch and confirmed twice. Check branch Delete content Delete All deletes every slideshow except the sample, with all their slides and files. The sample slideshow, your settings, logo and background colour are kept. It can't be undone. Delete All…
texts.switch dialog: Missing software main needs software this noticeboard doesn’t have, or has in a version that’s too old. Install it yourself before switching: until you do, the branch may not work. FFmpeg 4.0.0 or newer (this noticeboard has none). Processing uploaded videos. To install: sudo apt install ffmpeg FFprobe 4.0.0 or newer (this noticeboard has none). Reading the length of uploaded videos. To install: sudo apt install ffmpeg (FFprobe comes with it) Chromium any version (this noticeboard has none). Showing the slideshow full screen on this Pi's own screen. To install: sudo apt install chromium (on older Raspberry Pi OS: chromium-browser) I’ve installed it myself, or I accept that main may not work until I do. Cancel Continue
